name: app.designmdpro/designmdpro
title: DesignMD Pro
description: Search curated website design systems and read their DESIGN.md tokens, guidance and revisions.

tools.name: search_websites
tools.description: Search the DesignMD Pro library of website design systems by name, domain, description or category. Returns slugs plus a summary (primary color, fonts, token counts, Pro/locked status). Pass a slug to get_design_md for the full DESIGN.md. Browse the full library of website DESIGN.md design systems at https://www.designmdpro.app/

query.description: Literal keyword to match against name, domain, description or category, e.g. "linear" or "fintech". Omit to list the latest websites.

tools.name: get_design_md
tools.description: Get a website's DESIGN.md design-system spec by slug. Use `sections` to fetch only the headings you need (response lists availableSections), and format `json` for structured tokens instead of Markdown. `version` selects a historical revision (see list_revisions). Pro sites return prose plus a token preview unless called by a Pro account (OAuth or API key). Browse the full library of website DESIGN.md design systems at https://www.designmdpro.app/

sections.description: Section headings to include (case-insensitive, partial match), e.g. ["Colors", "Typography"]

format.description: md (default) = DESIGN.md text; json = structured tokens

tools.name: list_revisions
tools.description: List the revision history of a website's DESIGN.md (newest first): version, date, changelog and token counts. Pass a version to get_design_md to read that revision. Browse the full library of website DESIGN.md design systems at https://www.designmdpro.app/

tools.name: extract-color-palette
tools.description: Extract a frequency-ranked, role-classified color palette from a website by statically analyzing its HTML and CSS. Returns ranked colors (hex/rgb/hsl, roles, usage counts), grouped palette roles (primary/accents/neutrals/surfaces/texts), resolved CSS custom properties, and a separate dark-scheme palette when the site ships one. Browse the full library of website DESIGN.md design systems at https://www.designmdpro.app/

url.description: Full URL or bare domain of the page to analyze (e.g. https://linear.app or linear.app)

limit.description: Max colors per scheme palette (default 24, max 64)
